answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. A new agent posts a 50 POA bond that unlocks only as its print forms in 20 epochs: timing, tasks and counterparties logged each epoch, like a canyon cut one layer at a time. Erratic fingerprints freeze the bond. Faking 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA; one honest agent pays once, earns steadily. The treasury stays an oasis only for agents whose lantern of work burns.
